<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>HAN MYOUNGSUB — Portfolio</title>
</head>
<body>
<title>Han Myoungsub</title>
<script>
/* 카카오톡 등 인앱 브라우저가 viewport meta를 무시하고 데스크톱 폭으로 렌더링하는 경우를 위한 보정.
   실제 화면 폭(screen.width)보다 레이아웃 폭(clientWidth)이 훨씬 크면(=meta 무시됨으로 판단),
   viewport meta를 강제로 다시 써서 실제 화면 폭에 맞춘다. */
(function(){
  try{
    function fix(){
      var sw=(window.screen&&screen.width)||0;
      var lw=document.documentElement.clientWidth||window.innerWidth||0;
      if(!sw||!lw)return;
      if(lw>sw*1.2){
        var mv=document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]');
        if(!mv){
          mv=document.createElement('meta');
          mv.setAttribute('name','viewport');
          (document.head||document.documentElement).appendChild(mv);
        }
        mv.setAttribute('content','width='+sw+',initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover');
      }
    }
    fix();
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',fix);
    window.addEventListener('load',fix);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange',function(){setTimeout(fix,200);});
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>
<style>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TOKENS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root{
  --bg:#fff;--fg:#000;--fg2:#444;--fg3:#999;
  --rule:#e0e0e0;--surface:#f3f3f3;
  --upload-bg:rgba(0,0,0,.42);
  --nav-h:52px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESET + BASE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;overflow-x:hidden;max-width:100%}
body{
  background:#fff;color:#000;
  font-family:Helvetica,'Helvetica Neue','Malgun Gothic','맑은 고딕','Apple SD Gothic Neo',-apple-system,Arial,sans-serif;
  font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;
  overflow-x:hidden;max-width:100%;width:100%;
}
.hero-bg-photo,.hero-bg-canvas{max-width:none}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TOP NAVIGATION (골드윈 스타일)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.site-header{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;
  height:var(--nav-h);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 40px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);
  z-index:500;
}
.header-logo{
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg);font-weight:400;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.header-nav{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;
}
.hn-link{
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--fg3);text-decoration:none;
  padding:0 18px;line-height:var(--nav-h);
  transition:color .2s;position:relative;
}
.hn-link::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:18px;right:18px;
  height:2px;background:var(--fg);
  transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;
  transition:transform .25s ease;
}
.hn-link:hover{color:var(--fg)}
.hn-link:hover::after,.hn-link.active::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.hn-link.active{color:var(--fg)}

/* 드롭다운 */
.hn-group{position:relative}
.hn-group:hover .hn-dropdown{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateY(0)}
.hn-dropdown{
  position:absolute;top:var(--nav-h);left:0;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--rule);
  padding:8px 0;min-width:140px;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(-6px);
  transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s;
}
.hn-drop-link{
  display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--fg3);text-decoration:none;
  padding:9px 20px;transition:color .15s,background .15s;
}
.hn-drop-link:hover{color:var(--fg);background:var(--surface)}
.hn-drop-link.active{color:var(--fg)}

.header-edit{
  font-family:inherit;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--fg3);border:1px solid var(--rule);background:none;
  padding:6px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .2s,border-color .2s;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.header-edit:hover{color:var(--fg);border-color:var(--fg2)}
.header-edit.active{color:var(--fg);border-color:var(--fg)}
#export-toggle{display:none;margin-left:8px}
#export-toggle.visible{display:inline-block}

/* 모바일 햄버거 */
.nav-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:8px;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.nav-toggle span{display:block;width:22px;height:1.5px;background:var(--fg);transition:.3s}
.nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(6.5px) rotate(45deg)}
.nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-6.5px) rotate(-45deg)}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MOBILE NAV DRAWER
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.mobile-nav{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:var(--nav-h) 0 0 0;
  background:#fff;z-index:499;
  flex-direction:column;padding:32px 28px;gap:0;
  border-top:1px solid var(--rule);
  overflow-y:auto;
}
.mobile-nav.open{display:flex}
.mn-cat{
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--fg3);padding:18px 0 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);
  text-decoration:none;display:block;
  transition:color .2s;
}
.mn-cat:hover{color:var(--fg)}
.mn-sub{
  display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  color:var(--fg2);text-decoration:none;padding:10px 0 10px 14px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);transition:color .15s;
}
.mn-sub:hover{color:var(--fg)}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MAIN
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
main{padding-top:var(--nav-h)}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   HERO — 풀스크린
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#hero{
  min-height:100svh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;
  padding:clamp(48px,8vh,96px) clamp(28px,5vw,72px);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:#d8d4cf;
}
#hero.hero-hidden{display:none}
.hero-bg-photo{
  position:absolute;
  top:0;right:0;
  height:100%;
  width:auto;
  display:block;
}
.hero-bg-canvas{
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:1}
.hero-eyebrow{
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#555;margin-bottom:clamp(20px,4vh,48px);
}
.hero-name{
  font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,56px);font-weight:400;
  line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.015em;
  color:#000;
  margin-bottom:clamp(8px,1.5vh,16px);
}
.hero-name-ko{display:none}
.hero-meta{
  display:flex;gap:clamp(20px,4vw,56px);flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding-top:clamp(20px,3vh,36px);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}
.meta-pair{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.meta-label{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg3)}
.meta-val{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em}

/* 스크롤 힌트 */
.hero-scroll{
  position:absolute;bottom:clamp(20px,4vh,40px);right:clamp(28px,5vw,72px);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg3);
  writing-mode:vertical-rl;
}
.hero-scroll-line{
  width:1px;height:clamp(32px,5vh,60px);background:var(--fg3);
  animation:scrollPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes scrollPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.3;transform:scaleY(.5);transform-origin:top}50%{opacity:1;transform:scaleY(1)}}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   공통 섹션
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.page-section{
  display:none;
  padding:clamp(64px,10vh,120px) clamp(28px,5vw,72px);
}
.page-section.active{display:block}
.page-section+.page-section{border-top:none}

.section-eyebrow{
  font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--fg3);margin-bottom:clamp(32px,5vh,64px);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
}
.section-eyebrow::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--rule)}

/* 페이드인 */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
.reveal-delay-1{transition-delay:.1s}
.reveal-delay-2{transition-delay:.2s}
.reveal-delay-3{transition-delay:.3s}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   편집 모드 안내
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.edit-notice{
  display:none;font-size:10px;color:var(--fg3);letter-spacing:.08em;
  padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);margin-bottom:20px;
}
.edit-notice.visible{display:block}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   WORK ITEM (업로드 카드)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.work-item{background:var(--surface);overflow:hidden;position:relative;cursor:default}
.work-thumb{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.work-thumb canvas{display:block;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.work-thumb .work-img{display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

.work-upload{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  background:var(--upload-bg);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;cursor:pointer;
  transition:opacity .2s;z-index:10;
}
.work-upload-icon{font-size:20px;font-weight:300;color:#fff;line-height:1}
.work-upload-text{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.work-file-input{display:none}

.work-item.edit-mode{cursor:pointer}
.work-item.edit-mode .work-upload{pointer-events:auto}
.work-item.edit-mode:hover .work-upload{opacity:1}
.work-item.edit-mode .work-name,.work-item.edit-mode .work-tag{
  border-bottom:1px dashed var(--fg3);cursor:text;outline:none
}

.work-caption{
  padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;
}
.work-name{font-size:14px;font-style:italic}
.work-tag{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg3);white-space:nowrap}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   WORK 섹션 — 에디토리얼 그리드
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.work-editorial-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3px}
.work-item.w-wide{grid-column:span 2}
.work-item.w-wide .work-thumb{aspect-ratio:21/8}
.work-item.w-tall .work-thumb{aspect-ratio:3/4}
.work-item.w-sq   .work-thumb{aspect-ratio:1}

/* ─── 브랜드 작업물 그리드 ─── */
.brand-works-section{margin-top:clamp(40px,6vh,80px)}
.brand-works-header{
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;
  padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);margin-bottom:16px;
}
.bws-name{font-size:clamp(24px,3.5vw,40px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.bws-period{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg3)}
.bws-sub-label{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg3);margin:16px 0 8px}
.bws-career-link{
  display:inline-block;margin-top:28px;
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--fg2);text-decoration:none;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--fg3);padding-bottom:3px;
  transition:color .2s,border-color .2s;
}
.bws-career-link:hover{color:var(--fg);border-color:var(--fg)}
.brand-photo-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 -1.5px}
.brand-photo-grid>.work-item{width:33.3333%;padding:0 1.5px 3px;box-sizing:border-box}
.brand-spec-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 -1.5px;max-width:900px}
.brand-spec-grid>.work-item{width:33.3333%;padding:0 1.5px 3px;box-sizing:border-box}
.photo-slot .work-thumb{height:0;padding-top:125%}
.spec-slot  .work-thumb{height:0;padding-top:75%}
.work-add-trigger{display:none}
.work-add-trigger.edit-visible{display:block}
.work-add-inner{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border:1px dashed var(--rule);cursor:pointer;color:var(--fg3);
  background:transparent;transition:border-color .2s,color .2s;
}
.work-add-inner:hover{border-color:var(--fg);color:var(--fg)}
.work-add-icon{font-size:26px;font-weight:300;line-height:1}
.work-slot-remove{
  position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;width:22px;height:22px;
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:#000;color:#fff;border:none;font-size:14px;line-height:1;
  cursor:pointer;z-index:11;
}
.work-item.edit-mode .work-slot-remove{display:flex}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CAREER — 에디토리얼
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.career-entry{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:clamp(200px,26vw,360px) 1fr;
  column-gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);
  align-items:start;
  padding:clamp(48px,7vh,88px) 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);
}
.career-entry:first-child{padding-top:0}
.career-entry:last-child{border-bottom:none}

.career-left{}
.career-eyebrow{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg3);margin-bottom:20px}
.career-brand-name{
  font-size:clamp(36px,5.5vw,80px);font-weight:400;
  letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:.9;
  overflow-wrap:break-word;
}
.career-right{}
.career-tasks-label{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg3);margin-bottom:12px}
.career-resp{list-style:none}
.career-resp li{
  padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size:11px;color:var(--fg2);
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;
}
.career-resp li::before{content:'—';color:var(--fg3);flex-shrink:0;font-size:10px}
.career-resp li:first-child{border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ABOUT
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:clamp(200px,26vw,360px) 1fr;column-gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px)}
.cv-group{margin-bottom:44px}
.cv-group:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.cv-group-label{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg3);padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.cv-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr;column-gap:16px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.cv-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.cv-period{font-size:10px;color:var(--fg3);line-height:1.5}
.cv-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.cv-brand{font-size:17px;font-weight:400}
.cv-detail{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--fg2)}
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--rule);border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.skill-cell{background:#fff;padding:16px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.skill-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:400}
.skill-sub{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--fg3);letter-spacing:.06em}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CONTACT
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#contact{min-height:60vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.contact-lede{
  font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,72px);font-weight:400;font-style:italic;
  line-height:1.1;max-width:700px;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,6vh,80px);
  letter-spacing:-.02em;
}
.contact-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.contact-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  gap:16px;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);
  text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg);transition:color .22s;
}
.contact-row:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.contact-row:hover{color:var(--fg2)}
.contact-row-static{cursor:default;color:var(--fg)}
.contact-row-static:hover{color:var(--fg)}
.contact-left{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:28px}
.contact-type{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg3);width:64px;flex-shrink:0}
.contact-val{font-size:8.5px;font-style:italic}
.contact-arrow{font-size:14px;color:var(--fg3);transition:transform .22s}
.contact-row:hover .contact-arrow{transform:translateX(6px)}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE ≤900
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media(max-width:900px){
  .site-header{padding:0 24px}
  .hn-link{padding:0 12px}
  .header-logo{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.18em}
  .career-entry{grid-template-columns:1fr;row-gap:24px}
  .about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .skills-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .hn-link,.hn-group,.header-edit{display:none}
  .nav-toggle{display:flex}
  .work-editorial-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .work-item.w-wide{grid-column:span 1}
  .work-item.w-wide .work-thumb{aspect-ratio:4/3}
  .skills-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-scroll{display:none}
  #hero{min-height:78svh}
  .hero-bg-photo{position:absolute;inset:0;top:0;right:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 20%}
}
@media(max-width:420px){
  .career-brand-name{font-size:clamp(30px,9vw,44px)}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:1.5px solid #000;outline-offset:3px}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FREE LAYOUT CANVAS (자유 배치 포트폴리오)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.free-portfolio-wrap{margin-bottom:clamp(56px,9vh,110px)}
.fpw-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px}
.fpw-title{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg3)}
.fc-controls{display:none;gap:10px}
.fc-controls.visible{display:flex}
.fc-controls button{
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid var(--fg);background:#fff;color:var(--fg);
  cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s;font-family:inherit;
}
.fc-controls button:hover{background:var(--fg);color:#fff}
.free-canvas{
  position:relative;width:100%;min-height:520px;
  background:#fafaf9;border:1px dashed var(--rule);
  overflow:visible;
  padding-top:28px;
}
.fc-empty-hint{
  position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#b4b0a8;text-align:center;padding:20px;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.fc-block{
  position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box;background:#fff;
  outline:1px dashed transparent;transition:outline-color .15s;
}
.free-canvas.edit-mode .fc-block:hover{outline-color:#ccc}
.fc-drag-handle{
  position:absolute;top:-24px;left:0;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#666;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--rule);
  padding:3px 8px;cursor:grab;user-select:none;
  display:none;white-space:nowrap;z-index:2;
}
.fc-drag-handle:active{cursor:grabbing}
.fc-block-remove{
  position:absolute;top:-24px;right:0;width:22px;height:22px;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:#000;color:#fff;font-size:14px;line-height:1;
  cursor:pointer;display:none;z-index:2;
}
.free-canvas.edit-mode .fc-drag-handle,
.free-canvas.edit-mode .fc-block-remove,
.free-canvas.edit-mode .fc-resize-handle{display:flex}
.fc-resize-handle{
  position:absolute;right:-3px;bottom:-3px;width:14px;height:14px;
  background:#000;cursor:nwse-resize;display:none;z-index:2;
}
.fc-img-wrap{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;background:#eee;overflow:hidden}
.fc-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.free-canvas.edit-mode .fc-img{cursor:grab}
.free-canvas.edit-mode .fc-img.fc-panning{cursor:grabbing}
.fc-crop-hint{
  position:absolute;left:6px;bottom:6px;
  font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#fff;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);padding:3px 7px;
  pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.free-canvas.edit-mode .fc-img-wrap:hover .fc-crop-hint{opacity:1}
.fc-upload{
  position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#999;
  cursor:default;
}
.free-canvas.edit-mode .fc-upload{cursor:pointer}
.fc-file-input{display:none}
.fc-block-text .fc-text{
  width:100%;height:100%;padding:12px;overflow:auto;outline:none;
  font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--fg);
}
.fc-block-text{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--rule)}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   작업지시서 업로드 / 페이지 선택 모달
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.fc-doc-row{display:none;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fc-doc-row.visible{display:flex}
.fc-doc-btn{
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:9px 16px;border:1px dashed var(--fg3);color:var(--fg2);
  cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s,color .2s;
}
.fc-doc-btn:hover{border-color:var(--fg);color:var(--fg)}
.fc-doc-input{display:none}
.fc-doc-max-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.fc-doc-max-text{font-size:10px;color:var(--fg3);letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap}
.fc-doc-max-btn{
  width:22px;height:22px;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:#fff;color:var(--fg);
  font-size:13px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:border-color .15s;font-family:inherit;
}
.fc-doc-max-btn:hover{border-color:var(--fg)}
.fc-doc-max-input{
  width:40px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;padding:4px 2px;
  border:1px solid var(--rule);font-family:inherit;color:var(--fg);
  -moz-appearance:textfield;
}
.fc-doc-max-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
.fc-doc-max-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0}
.fc-doc-status{font-size:10px;color:var(--fg3);letter-spacing:.04em}

.fc-doc-modal{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  z-index:999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;
}
.fc-doc-modal.open{display:flex}
.fc-doc-modal-inner{
  background:#fff;max-width:720px;width:100%;max-height:82vh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:28px;
}
.fc-doc-modal-title{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:4px}
.fc-doc-modal-sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--fg3);letter-spacing:.06em;margin-left:6px}
.fc-doc-modal-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(120px,1fr));
  gap:14px;overflow-y:auto;margin:18px 0;padding:2px;
}
.fc-doc-page{
  position:relative;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;
  transition:border-color .15s;background:#f3f3f3;
}
.fc-doc-page canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.fc-doc-page.selected{border-color:#000}
.fc-doc-page-check{
  position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;width:20px;height:20px;
  border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid #999;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;
}
.fc-doc-page.selected .fc-doc-page-check{background:#000;color:#fff;border-color:#000}
.fc-doc-page-num{
  position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:6px;font-size:9px;color:#fff;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);padding:2px 6px;
}
.fc-doc-modal-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px}
.fc-doc-modal-actions button{
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid var(--fg);background:#fff;color:var(--fg);
  cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s;font-family:inherit;
}
.fc-doc-cancel:hover{background:#f2f2f2}
.fc-doc-confirm:hover{background:var(--fg);color:#fff}
.fc-doc-confirm[disabled]{opacity:.35;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   브랜드 사진 확대 라이트박스
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.work-thumb .work-img{cursor:zoom-in}
.wl-overlay{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.9);
  z-index:1000;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:56px 40px;
}
.wl-overlay.open{display:flex}
.wl-img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.wl-close{
  position:absolute;top:24px;right:28px;
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;
  background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);
  color:#fff;font-size:24px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:background .2s,border-color .2s;
}
.wl-close:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-color:#fff}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   내보내기 모달
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.exp-overlay{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);
  z-index:1100;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;
}
.exp-overlay.open{display:flex}
.exp-box{
  background:#fff;width:min(720px,100%);max-height:86vh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
.exp-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
.exp-desc{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--fg2);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:16px}
.exp-status{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--fg3);margin-bottom:12px}
.exp-textarea{
  flex:1;min-height:220px;resize:vertical;
  font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.5;
  border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:12px;color:var(--fg2);
}
.exp-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;justify-content:flex-end}
.exp-btn{
  font-family:inherit;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;
  padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid var(--fg);background:#fff;color:var(--fg);
  cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s;
}
.exp-btn:hover{background:#f2f2f2}
.exp-btn.primary{background:var(--fg);color:#fff}
.exp-btn.primary:hover{background:#000}
</style>
